sections.heading: Priors disclosure
sections.markdown: Market narrative (from memory): ANTM.JK is Indonesia's state-owned miner under MIND ID, driven by gold trading/mining margins and nickel ore/ferronickel volumes under RKAB quotas and mining royalties.

sections.heading: Earnings quality gate
sections.markdown:
- **3y Accruals & CFO/NI (`data/dossiers/ANTM.fund record`, `fund record` F14/F17/F20/F34, `sources/S9.txt`–`fund record`):** Using `CFO = FCF + |Capex|`: FY23A CFO Rp4,357.3bn vs NI Rp3,077.6bn (**141.6%** CFO/NI, Sloan **−3.35%**); FY24A Rp3,681.1bn vs Rp3,647.2bn (**100.9%**, **−0.08%**); FY25A Rp4,853.3bn vs Rp7,208.8bn (**67.3%**, **+4.85%**). 3y mean Sloan accruals = **+0.47%** (<10% threshold). Unaudited 9M2026 CFO fell to Rp5,060bn vs Group NI Rp9,660bn (**52.4%**; **57.3%** of Parent NI Rp8,830bn; **37.5%** of EBITDA Rp13,480bn) — **optics/WC drag**, not fraud.
- **Working capital & inventory (`fund record`, `F1–F5/S9`):** `fund record` (S0) records FY25 gross NWC at Rp8.46trn (**10.0%** of sales: inventories Rp7.73trn + receivables Rp2.33trn − payables Rp1.60trn) and +Rp2.29trn 1H26 NWC build. In 9M26, ore output (12.16m wmt) exceeded sales (10.73m wmt), while FeNi sales (13,971 TNi, +71% y/y) outpaced production (11,638 TNi) via ~2.33 kt inventory drawdown (non-recurring post-26E).
- **IDX board, split, royalties, RKAB, DHE, IUPK:** No IDX special-monitoring board or notation flags (`fund record` §3, `fund record`). 9M26 is unaudited (expect Q4 true-ups; Q4 25 posted −Rp932.7bn EBIT). Revenue split (`S9`): Gold **77.3%** (Rp68,410bn; 25,217 kg sold vs 634 kg Pongkor output — ~97.5% traded/refined bullion), Nickel **19.2%** (Rp16,980bn), Bauxite/Alumina **3.0%** (Rp2,640bn). PP 19/2025 (`S28`, F59) charges **14%** on nickel ore and **4%** on FeNi (<US$18/kg HMA), though `S19` flags CIF-below-HPM pricing lifts effective royalties. 2026 national RKAB (290–300m t, F31/F41) sits below 2025 output (379m t, F32) with a 2027 cut signalled (`S15`) and national saprolite life <10y (F42/S17); Kepmen 363/2026 cut limonite CF (26%→14%) while holding saprolite at 30% (`S24`), matching ANTM's saprolite-order 1H26 realisation (Rp1.265m/wmt, F54–F55/`S2`). **95%** domestic 9M26 sales (F33/`S11`) mute DHE FX retention drag. fund record ID control removes *konglo* pledge/IUPK divestment risk (`fund record` §6) but adds policy capex (Mempawah, Buli, Gresik, `S12`/`S25`/`S29`), procurement flags (KPK artisanal-gold warning `S12`), and **8.6%** minority leakage (F17/F34). **Gate: PASS WITH OPTICS/WC HAIRCUTS.**

sections.heading: Variant perception
sections.markdown:
**Market believes:** At Rp2,680/sh, ANTM trades like an unhedged nickel miner facing ~800kt oversupply (F35/`S15`), RKAB risk, and SOE discount — pricing <$9k/t LME nickel and ignoring gold.
**Why wrong:** Gold refining/retail bullion supplies 77% of revenue and ~70% of GP alongside Rp4.8trn net cash and a 70% payout (`S3`); even at Spot ($16,324 Ni / $3,779 Au), NAV is Rp3,246/sh (+21%), and Base NAV is Rp3,796/sh (+42%) under Indonesia's `FAVOR` nickel supply-discipline stance (`the macro regime memo`).
**What proves us wrong:** Nickel drops to ~$14k/t alongside a ≥20% RKAB cut AND bullion demand/spreads compress (gold ~$3,655/oz, non-Ni GM ≤12%) with persistent NWC cash burn.

sections.heading: House coverage reconciliation
sections.markdown: Our Base NAV (**Rp3,796/sh**) sits 12.6% below house `tp_final` (**Rp4,344/sh**, `fund record`) and 18.1% below `dcf_life` (**Rp4,637/sh**) for three reasons: (1) we omit the Rp10,017bn `investments` add-back to avoid double-counting JV associates alongside Rp4.5trn growth capex at cost + Rp4.8trn Sep-26 net cash, and apply **15.2%** WACC vs 14.55%; (2) we strip ~2.33 kt FeNi inventory release post-FY26E and charge 10% gross NWC throughout; (3) house `tp_final` rolls `v0` (Rp3,934) forward 12m at Ke less DPS and weights a Rp6,668 Bull 25%, whereas our Rp3,800 target anchors to unrolled Base NAV. Both frameworks agree ANTM is mispriced against spot and through-cycle fundamentals.

sections.heading: Disconfirming facts
sections.markdown:
1. **9M26 cash conversion trails earnings:** OCF Rp5,060bn was 37.5% of EBITDA (Rp13,480bn) and 52.4% of Group NI (Rp9,660bn; F14/F20/F34/`S9`/`S11`).
2. **FeNi growth relied on inventory draw:** 9M26 sales (13,971 TNi, +71% y/y) exceeded production (11,638 TNi; F3/F5/`S9`).
3. **Ore output trails guidance & spot gold trails deck:** 9M26 ore output (12.16m wmt) is 67.6% of FY26 18m t guidance (F2/F30/`S11`); Nov-18 GC=F gold ($3,779/oz, `fund record`) sits 12.1% below FY27E $4,300/oz.
4. **Policy & procurement friction:** KPK warned on small-scale gold sourcing (`S12`), `S19` documents CIF ore pricing below FOB HPM, and ANTM's RKAB/reserve report is unarchived.

sections.markdown: It is Nov-2029 and ANTM.JK lost 30%+: 2027 RKAB quotas failed to clear global supply (or cut ANTM saprolite >20% / HPM trimmed saprolite CF), LME nickel fell toward $14k/t, gold dropped toward $3,600/oz compressing retail spreads, and Buli/Gresik capex drained cash. Under IDX ±25% ARB bands, a shock could gap 1 ARB session below Rp1,925 (~Rp1,440 fill, −46%).
